mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used here to convey a meaning contrary to their literal meaning."
Words are used here to convey a meaning contrary to their literal meaning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the opposite of literal language."
Figurative language is the opposite of literal language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an emotional appeal used in rhetoric that depicts certain emotional states."
Pathos is an emotional appeal used in rhetoric that depicts certain emotional states.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a play of words - either their different meanings or upon two different words sounding the same."
Pun is a play of words - either their different meanings or upon two different words sounding the same.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an art and has very little to do with (the) information dissemination even though it does communicate some information."
Creative writing is an art and has very little to do with (the) information dissemination even though it does communicate some information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the biggest challenges facing most fiction writers."
Character creation is one of the biggest challenges facing most fiction writers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a more focused writing than an autobiography or a biography."
The memoir is a more focused writing than an autobiography or a biography.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the central idea or meaning of a story."
A theme is the central idea or meaning of a story.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a set of tools that are essential for all writers."
Figures of Speech are a set of tools that are essential for all writers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the art of persuasion through emotion, but using elements of logic or reason."
Rhetoric is the art of persuasion through emotion, but using elements of logic or reason.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ancient phrase with which Arabs have sought to underscore the important position reserved for poetry within their cultural heritage."
The register of the Arabs is the ancient phrase with which Arabs have sought to underscore the important position reserved for poetry within their cultural heritage.
